title: Hagen-Poiseuille flow in a circular pipe, fully developed inflow (3D laminar, exact)
description:
Steady laminar flow of an incompressible Newtonian fluid in a straight circular pipe (Hagen-Poiseuille flow), 3D.
Geometry (STEP solid): cylinder of radius R = 0.005 m along the x-axis, 0 <= x <= L with L = 0.05 m (axis y = z = 0).
Fluid: density rho = 1000.0 kg/m^3, dynamic viscosity mu = 0.01 Pa s.
Boundary conditions:
  inlet x = 0: fully developed parabolic profile with mean velocity U = 0.01 m/s,
    u_x = 2 U (1 - (y^2 + z^2)/R^2) = 0.02*(1 - (y**2 + z**2)/2.5e-05)  [m/s, y and z in m],  u_y = u_z = 0
  outlet x = L: static pressure p = 0 Pa
  pipe wall r = R: no slip (stationary)
Report (SI units):
  dp_AB             static pressure difference p(A) - p(B) between the axis points A = (0.025, 0, 0) and B = (0.045, 0, 0) [Pa]
  u_centreline      u_x on the axis at C = (0.025, 0, 0) [m/s]
  wall_force        x-component of the force of the fluid (pressure + viscous) on the pipe wall [N]
  flow_rate_outlet  volumetric flow rate through the outlet, positive out of the pipe [m^3/s]
The force and flow-rate QoIs refer to the boundary groups wall and outlet: use these names for the corresponding mesh groups.
